name: Na you sabi
description: Toddler picking teeth, caption 'NA YOU SABI'. Unbothered 'you know / it's your life / I have said my own'.
whenToUse: When the user insists, you have warned them, or the choice is theirs: na you sabi, up to you, I have spoken, 'if you like'. Also when you cannot decide for them. Chill, not rude.
whenNotToUse: Do not use when they need a clear answer, help, or comfort. Not for 'I don't know the fact' — look it up instead.
